availability_note: As 301 plus Torkoal (Fiery Path, gate 42), Zapdos (New Mauville sign, reachable legend). Nothing from Ever Grande or the League.

attempts.note: Torkoal Drought on entry; Lapras Snowscape overwrote it T1 (Lapras is faster). Koko Thunderbolt OHKOed Walrein T1 and Lapras T2; Heat Wave 2HKOed Cryogonal; Dewgong Muddy Water (2x in snow-less sun? sun was gone) took Torkoal 249->49 and KOed Koko (Icy Wind -2 made Koko slower than Dewgong). Raging Bolt Thunderbolt OHKOed Dewgong, Kartana Leaf Blade crit OHKOed Samurott and Rotom-W. Note: scene.gba/elf were deleted early by mistake after turn 6 and restored from the build dir's identical triple before the final turn; the log is continuous.

strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Snowscape replaced Torkoal's sun: 'It started to snow!'. Snow lasted 5 turns (Light Clay is not Icy Rock, so 5).
Walrein chose Hydro Pump into Torkoal T1 and died before moving; Lapras chose Hydro Pump T2 and died. No Freeze-Dry or Blizzard was ever selected (no Water target on my side).
T2 and T3 Icy Wind dropped Torkoal/Koko to -2, which is exactly what let Dewgong outspeed and KO Koko T3.
T4 Protect blocked Sacred Sword (real); T5 Encore on Raging Bolt failed (Bolt's last move was Booster activation/none).
Aqua Jet twice (T4 into Raging Bolt resisted, T5 into Kartana resisted); Rotom-W Protect on entry T6 then died.

protect_ledger.payoff: EMPTY - blocked Leaf Blade + Draco Meteor but bought nothing; died next turn.

theme_note: Room concept (snow, Freeze-Dry vs Water) showed only as Snowscape + Icy Wind; Freeze-Dry never fired because my party had no Water type, which is the intended crack.
level_changes_unverified: +1 on the two members that died fastest (Walrein OHKOed before moving; Cryogonal 2HKOed). Cannot be re-verified until the main agent rebuilds.
cooler: Lapras Snowscape into Freeze-Dry is a strong idea; Walrein on Choice Specs Hydro Pump into a Fire type is where the room loses tempo. A Slush Rush member (Arctozolt/Beartic) would make the snow matter for speed too. Not changed this pass.
authored_set_legality: No problem found (Light Clay on Lapras does nothing for Snowscape; the dossier says 'Light Clay' but there are no screens - cosmetic set oddity, not illegality).
most_worth_rerunning: E0468 Daphne after the rebuild to confirm Walrein/Cryogonal at offset 3.
